text:
maria: Heads-up — opened docs PR for the rate/quotas migration. linking examples, dashboard panels, and SDK snippet updates. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342

joel: :eyes: Nice. Do we have stable panel IDs for prod vs staging? reviewers will need the right links.

maria: Not yet — added a TODO in the PR. tagging analytics: @alex can you confirm panel_id mapping? also we need localization for EU phrasing.

alex: I will dump the panel ids into the PR comment this afternoon. quick Q: do we want VAT-inclusive pricing examples in the docs or a separate EU note?

lina: For legal we should show both net and gross examples. I can add a short EU section and i18n keys.

sam: SDK snippets note: header behavior changed in v2 (see SDK change log). prefer using the new header pattern in examples. sample curl I pushed to the PR branch for review:
```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"hello"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I'll add language variants (python/js) once we lock the header names.

maria: Thanks. I put a short checklist in the PR description:
- [ ] panel ids updated
- [ ] EU copy + i18n keys
- [ ] SDK snippets for curl/python/js (v2 headers)
- [ ] docs redirect/anchor fixes for dashboards
- [ ] staging preview posted

deploy-bot: preview published -> https://redwood-inference-docs-staging.netlify.app/pr-5342 :rocket:

joel: small nit — when linking to dashboards from PR add `?env=staging` so reviewers land on the staging panels.

maria: Updated the links and added a comment about `?env=staging`. tagging @alex @lina for final confirm on wording and panel ids.

alex: Confirmed panel ids and posted a JSON mapping in PR comment: panel_traffic=panel-42, panel_costs=panel-77, panel_quota=panel-81.

lina: Pushed EU localization branch with translations and the VAT examples. also flagged copy change: prefer 'billing period' over 'billing cycle' in the examples.

maria: Pulled the EU branch into this PR, merged a few minor wording fixes. Running full docs build locally before merge: `yarn docs:build` — takes ~3m.

joel: CI flaky today — if Pipelines fail, can we land the copy fixes in a follow-up? nothing blocking the main migration docs.

maria: Agreed. If CI is red I'll split non-critical nit fixes into a follow-up PR. current plan: wait for pipeline, then merge PR #5342.

maria: Merged minor fixes, landing once Pipelines green. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

docs-bot: PR #5342 merged to main by maria
